caption: The drawing depicts a section of an ornate wrought iron fence rendered in shades of black and gray on a light, beige background. The fence consists of three vertical bars each topped with stylized floral finials, and two side panels that are highly decorative with symmetrical scrollwork and leaf motifs. The central vertical bar is also adorned with scroll patterns and floral details. To the right of the fence is a larger, more prominent post or pillar, featuring several horizontal rings, a flared base, and a conical cap with layered elements. The entire composition is centrally placed on the paper with ample blank margin space surrounding the design.
title: Fencing
